basic_details.job_title: Bharathiar University Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Bharathiar University has released the official Project Assistant Notification 2026 on its official website. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the Bharathiar University Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 on a contractual basis. Candidates with an M.Sc. in Physics are eligible to apply via email on or before 27 July 2026. The official notification PDF and application details are available below.

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 27-07-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant position at Bharathiar University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Assistant position at Bharathiar University is 27th July 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Physics to be eligible for the Project Assistant position at Bharathiar University. Ensure your qualification matches this requirement.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the Project Assistant vacancy?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000. This is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by Bharathiar University.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant post in the Bharathiar University recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The position of Project Assistant is offered on a contractual basis by Bharathiar University.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Bharathiar University located?
faq.answer: Bharathiar University is located in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 641046.
